Bhutan
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in New Delhi, India.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Paris.
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the Kingdom of Bhutan are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in New Delhi, India.
